row.name: A+ Kidz Care Learning Center 2, LLC

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids: During the investigation, it was found that staff did not wear gloves when handling blood from a child who was injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3425(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers were last serviced February 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: A caregiver caring for children under the age of 24 months lacked documentation of current SIDS/Shaken Baby Training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two out of ten children's files evaluated lacked an updated immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered, a caregiver failed to use good judgment when she is seen on video forcefully sliding a child's chair, resulting in the child falling and hitting the table.     In addition, the caregiver and another caregiver failed to use good judgment by using a pointer "stick" to hit the table to scare the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On a playground, the metal covering around the drinking fountain was detached from the wall, exposing sharp metal. Note: This was corrected when the metal was attached back to the wall.    Some drains on the playground were lacking appropriate sealant/ caulking, which resulted in gaps being exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: The operation did not follow the background check provisional conditions of a caregiver.    Note: This was corrected when a second caregiver was added to the class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Record Storage- Location: Personnel files were not complete/available within a reasonable amount of time. Inspectors waited over three hours and all files were not completely provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Record Storage- Location (26 TAC §746.907(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A two month old, who is unable to roll over was observed sleeping on his stomach.    Note: The caregiver rolled the child to his back when it was brought to her attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A two month old was observed sleeping with a burp rag in the crib.    Note: The burp rag was removed when it was brought to the caregivers attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was briefly observed with eleven children at nap time with a specified age group 12m-17m.     Note: This was corrected when a second caregiver entered the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver was observed grabbing several children by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The consumer product safety recall was last certified January 3, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: Diaper cream and sunscreen were observed in the bathroom and were accessible to the children.    Note: This was corrected when the caregiver removed the items.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Two out of ten children's files evaluated lacked a special needs statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Two caregivers lacked an employee affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One out of ten children's files evaluated lacked an updated shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Two out of ten personnel files evaluated lacked current first aid/CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Clear, Positive Statements: Caregivers did not use positive statements when redirecting children from climbing on the tables.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Clear, Positive Statements (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(B))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: One out of ten personnel files evaluated lacked current SIDS/Shaken Baby training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: Based on information gathered through a DFPS investigation, a caregiver did not know the names of the children she was responsible for. A child was crying when two other children were on top of him. The caregiver did not know the names of the children involved and did not check the child for any injuries.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: One child did not wash their hands after having their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: One caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The caterpillar play structure on the playground was observed to be cracked.    Note: This was corrected when a caregiver removed the caterpillar from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: The infant classroom was not utilizing their individual storage when all backpacks/ diaper bags were stored on the floor, accessible to the children.    Note: This was corrected when the caregiver removed the backpacks/ diaper bags from the floor and placed them on hooks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of ten children's records evaluated lacked an updated shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, a caregiver was observed and admitted to draping her leg over children who were laying on their cots to force them to remain still and stop getting up during naptime in order to control their behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, a caregiver was observed by other caregivers and admitted to yelling at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))
